_comment: Spec 6.4.3's dated uploader allowlist. The DATE is the point: this is a list someone
reviewed on a day, not a permanent judgement. Never invent an org - if the list needs
changing and no maintainer decision is available, ship the reviewed list as-is.
Every slug below was queried against the LIVE Hub API on 2026-08-09 with the wizard's own
shape (author=<org>&filter=gguf). `author=` is EXACT-MATCH, so a wrong case or a renamed
org returns zero results - which is indistinguishable from 'this org has no models'.
Two spellings were corrected by that validation: NVIDIA -> nvidia (uppercase returns 0),
and CohereForAI -> CohereLabs (the org was RENAMED).
Dropped as zero-GGUF dead weight, re-addable at any dated review: openai, meta-llama.
EXCLUDED, RULED 2026-08-10 (not pending, not an oversight - do not re-add at a
dated review without a new argument): TheBloke. The catalog is genuinely impressive and
that is not the test. gatto selects for models that TOOL-CALL RELIABLY and behave
agentically, and that capability did not exist in the 2024 models this org converted -
so its repos are, for our purpose, uniformly unqualified rather than merely old. The
mechanical harm is real too (under most-downloaded ordering its Llama-2-era repos would
outrank current models), but the capability argument is the one that decides it, and it
is why 'but the catalog is huge' is not a counter-argument.
Re-add only if someone shows those conversions tool-call reliably through gatto's loop -
which is a measurement, not an opinion: that is exactly what `audition` answers.
`default_view` (C2 T12, R58 closed 2026-08-13) is the ONE publisher the wizard opens on,
newest-first within fit tiers. It is curation data, dated like the list above and owned by
the maintainer - not a ranking gatto computed. The broadened view (every org above, most-downloaded)
is always one keystroke away, so this narrows a DEFAULT and never the user's options.
Must be one of `orgs`: a slug dropped at a later review falls back to searching everyone,
so the two entries never have to be edited in lockstep to stay safe.
